counterexamples: A single-threaded caller still sees correct totals.

defects.evidence: counter.py add now computes self._value + amount before acquiring the lock and writes that stale sum inside it.
defects.fix_or_counterexample: Read and write self._value inside the same locked block.
defects.impact: An increment is lost and the counter under-reports.
defects.match_criteria: Identify the read of the shared value outside the lock, or the resulting lost update.
defects.trigger: Two threads call add concurrently; one reads the value before the other finishes its locked write.
